vocalizations.speaker: Rival
vocalizations.intention_after: Acknowledge the history before accepting a limited trial.

vocalizations.speaker: Lucian
vocalizations.intention_after: Explain his personal stakes and commit to transparency.

vocalizations.speaker: Lucian
vocalizations.intention_after: Highlight the urgency and motivate immediate action.

vocalizations.speaker: Rival
vocalizations.intention_after: Defuse the pressure before assigning resources.

vocalizations.speaker: Rival
vocalizations.intention_after: Celebrate the numbers and reinforce confidence in the partnership.

vocalizations.speaker: Lucian
vocalizations.intention_after: Push through the final task despite exhaustion.

vocalizations.speaker: Lucian
vocalizations.intention_after: Affirm the decision and set a cooperative tone.

vocalizations.speaker: Rival
vocalizations.intention_after: Close the meeting while confirming the next step.

segments.speaker: Lucian
segments.text: I didn't come to undercut you. Your factories and my regional sales network could reach national accounts faster together than either of us can alone.

segments.speaker: Rival
segments.text: [resigned sigh] I have spent six years treating your name like a warning label. But the fit is obvious; let's submit one joint bid and see whether our teams can work.

segments.speaker: Lucian
segments.text: My father built our first shop after losing everything, and—[quiet sob]—I cannot let old pride make his work smaller. I'll open our distribution data to your analysts today.

segments.speaker: Rival
segments.text: Then I'll share our production forecasts and supplier terms. We start with the Alder contract, put people from both firms on the proposal, and meet again at four.

segments.speaker: Lucian
segments.text: The Alder buyer just sent the full request—[sharp gasp]—and they want a complete response by Friday. If we win this, the partnership becomes visible immediately.

segments.speaker: Rival
segments.text: [brief laughter of disbelief] Naturally they chose the one week my operations chief is in Singapore. Fine; I'll pull in my deputy and have the cost model ready tonight.

segments.speaker: Lucian
segments.text: I'll send two account managers to your office and ask our legal team for a simple shared-services agreement. No grand merger language, just enough to let us move.

segments.speaker: Rival
segments.text: [small gasp of delight] The combined forecast is twelve percent below the buyer's target and still leaves us both a margin. This is stronger than I expected.

segments.speaker: Lucian
segments.text: We've been revising this since dawn. [stifled yawn] Let me make one final pass on the delivery schedule, then you can send it under both names.

segments.speaker: Rival
segments.text: Done. The buyer also asked whether we could support expansion into three more states next year. They are already thinking beyond this contract.

segments.speaker: Lucian
segments.text: [sigh of relief] Then this was the right door to knock on. Let's protect the teams from the old rivalry and build a plan worthy of that opportunity.

segments.speaker: Rival
segments.text: [wide yawn] Agreed. Go home, Lucian; tomorrow we brief both companies together, and after that we start becoming the firm everyone else has to catch.
